abilities.name: Disintegrate
abilities.description: Argus' abilities apply a stack of Disintegration for 2s, causing subsequent instances of ability damage to deal 4 (+3%) bonus magical damage. Each stack of Disintegration deals 50% more damage, stacking infinitely (capped at 12 against Monsters).

abilities.name: Arcrune Conduit
abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing 55 (+55%) physical damage.

abilities.name: Dread Nova
abilities.description: Argus lobs an unstable orb of energy. Upon landing it explodes, dealing 80/120/160/200/240 (+50%) magical damage to all nearby Targets and Stuns them for 1/1.05/1.1/1.15/1.2s.

abilities.name: Ether Crystal
abilities.description: Argus summons an Ether Crystal at the target location for 2s. The Crystal will Push Enemy Heroes from the center and Lift Allied Heroes into the air before producing a storm that deals 15/25/35/45/55 (+18%) magical damage every 0.5s to nearby Enemies and Slows by 25/30/35/40/45% for 0.5s. After the duration the Crystal will implode, Pulling all Enemies within to the center.

abilities.name: Particle Shredder
abilities.description: Argus fires homing projectiles from his Abyssal Staff for up to 3.5s. Each projectile consumes mana and deals 13/20/27/34/41 (+18%) per blast. At maximum rank, Particle Shredder can be used indefinitely.

abilities.name: Synaptic Obliterator
abilities.description: After a short delay, Argus channels for up to 8s, gaining immunity to pushes and pulls whilst deploying his ultimate weapon to fire up to 3/4/5 powerful Energy Beams. Each beam deals 100/130/160 (+25%) magical damage (increased by up to 150% based on the Target's missing health) and Slows Enemies hit by 60% for 0.5s.

augments.name: Arcane Engine
augments.description: Dealing Ability Damage to Heroes grants you 1.75% Movement Speed for 1.5s, stacking infinitely - 0.15s CD.

augments.name: Mana Catalyst
augments.description: Restore Mana equal to 10% of damage dealt to Heroes, reduced to 1.5% for Non-Heroes. Basic Attacks restore 2x more.

augments.name: Infinite Obliteration
augments.description: Synaptic Obliterator's projectile now have infinite range, travel 25% faster, and Slow for 50% longer.

abilities.name: Nevermore
abilities.description: Nevermore activates every 15.0/14.5/14.0/13.5/13.0/12.5/12.0/11.5/11.0/10.5/10.0/9.5/9.0/8.5/8.0/7.5/7.0/6.5s (-0.5 per Level), empowering Kira. While empowered, Kira's next Basic Attack or Mercy blast fires a Raven at the target that explodes on impact, dealing (+7% of the Target's Current Health) physical damage to all targets in a small area.

abilities.name: Dusk
abilities.description: Passive: Apply Vengeance to enemies by dealing basic attack or ability damage, increasing damage you deal to them by 0.75% for 3.5s, stacking infinitely. Active: Purify all Enemy Units afflicted with Vengeance, dealing 45.0/65.0/85.0/105.0/125.0 physical damage, plus an additional 6.0/8.0/10.0/12.0/14.0 (+12% physical power) damage per stack, and Slowing them by 10.0/15.0/20.0/25.0/30.0% for 1s. The cooldown is reset if Dusk kills any target.

abilities.name: Shadow Glide
abilities.description: Dash 475.0/525.0/575.0/625.0/675.0 units in your current movement direction, becoming briefly Unselectable and gaining an additional 5.0/10.0/15.0/20.0/25.0 Bonus Physical Power for 4s, stacking up to 5 times. Cooldown Resets on Takedown.

abilities.name: Mercy
abilities.description: Equip Mercy to fire a powerful shot dealing 20.0/25.0/30.0/35.0/40.0 (+74.0/78.0/82.0/86.0/90.0% physical power) physical damage and applying 3 stacks of Vengeance to the Target. Mercy benefits from Lifesteal, can Critically Strike, and applies on-hit effects.

abilities.name: Purge
abilities.description: Unleash a torrent of arrows and bullets for 2.5s, dealing 225.0/330.0/435.0 (+460% physical power) physical damage to all nearby Enemies over the duration and reducing their healing by 45% for 2s. These attacks benefit from lifesteal and can critically strike. While Purge is active, Kira cannot attack or cast abilities, except Shadow Glide, and is Slowed by 30%.

augments.name: Bringer Of Mercy
augments.description: Mercy costs 10 less Mana and reduces Kira's Current Ability Cooldowns by 0.75s upon dealing damage.

augments.name: Lenore
augments.description: Shadow Glide refreshes the cooldown of Nevermore and it deals (+30% physical power) bonus Damage.

augments.name: Siphoning Purge
augments.description: Purge Heals for 25% of its damage dealt to Heroes.
